result.title: MCL: Meta Convolution Layer
result.summary: Dynamic convolution enhances convolutional neural networks (CNNs) by adapting kernels to input content, but it expresses the effective kernel as a linear mixture of a small number of basis kernels, which limits expressivity and complicates optimization as the mixture size grows. In this work, we revisit dynamic convolution from a functional perspective and propose the Meta Convolution Layer (MCL), which directly models the convolutional kernel as an input-conditioned function W(x) realized via a high-order polynomial expansion. Leveraging nested residual blocks inspired by deep polynomial networks, MCL implements a structured polynomial meta-network that generates a single input-adaptive kernel, thereby decoupling representational power from the explicit number of mixture kernels and alleviating training instability. MCL is a plug-in addition with standard convolutions and can be seamlessly integrated into both CNN and transformer backbones. Experimental evaluation shows that adding MCL improves the Top-1 accuracy of Resnet- 18, Resnet-50 and ResNet-101 by 6.61%, 3.42% and 3.05% on the ImageNet dataset. Moreover, the proposed method significantly boosts the accuracy of Resnet and Wide-Resnet variants on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets. Additionally, the proposed method outperforms previous methods on fine-grained visual classification tasks using Swin and ViT backbones. These results demonstrate that high-order polynomial kernel generation is a powerful and scalable alternative to linear mixture based dynamic convolution.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Meta Convolution Layer，将卷积核建模为输入条件的高阶多项式函数，用嵌套残差块构成结构化元网络、生成单一自适应核，可插入 CNN 与 Transformer，在 ImageNet、CIFAR 及细粒度分类上提升精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由输入条件生成参数、以高阶多项式取代线性混合基核」的设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉条件化的 latent 状态生成及规避线性混合带来的信息坍缩提供方法线索，是否可迁移待核查。
